title: Good organizer to hang on a wall or put in a drawer; smells a bit; wish hinge was on bottom
text:
Good organizer to hang on a wall or put in a drawer; smells a bit; wish hinge was on bottom. There are four compartments in this set with one opening each for quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack bags. The entire unit can be hung on the wall with the supplied screws and plastic mollies. The holder can also be placed in a drawer that is large enough to hold it.

Overall, this is a nice organizer that does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets. I like everything about this organizer except for the smell and the hinge placement. The smell is offensive to me but I suspect that will dissipate over time. In fact, every other organizer of this type I tried, has a smell to it. The hinge placement is on top when it should be on the bottom of the organizer. When this is hung on the wall, it is impossible to replace the bags by opening the unit because they fall out. If the hinge was on the bottom, at least there would be the ability to open the door only part way when feeding the bags in. Of course, I could just feed the bags through the holes without opening the unit up but it is not as easy.

Also, I would have preferred the snack bag label to be the right most compartment so that the bags are organized in size order.

In summary, this is a nice organizer. However, the current price of $31.44 ($36.99 minus 15%) is slightly pricey for this. For something more configurable and with sliding drawers (but higher price), then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J organizer]].
